source_data: fictional local facts and synthetic mailbox previews

findings.message_en: The draft-contract email preview gives April 2024 as the start date, while your saved Northwind contract fact says January 2025. This may affect your open date-confirmation task, but the preview does not establish whether it is the same contract or which date is correct. Does the full draft refer to the Northwind contract? Check it before signing or sending corrected dates.
findings.message_zh: 合同草稿邮件预览中的开始日期为2024年4月，而你保存的 Northwind 合同开始日期为2025年1月。这可能与待办的日期确认任务有关，但仅凭预览无法确定是否为同一份合同，也无法判断哪个日期正确。完整草稿是否指 Northwind 合同？签署或发送更正日期前，请先核对全文。

findings.message_en: An email preview reports that OrchardDemo changed from private to public, conflicting with your saved requirement that it remain private. The report is unverified; check the repository’s actual visibility and restore private access if confirmed.
findings.message_zh: 邮件预览称 OrchardDemo 已从私有改为公开，这与你保存的“应保持私有”的要求冲突。目前尚未核实；请检查仓库的实际可见性，如确认已公开，应恢复为私有。
